failure.exception: arc3.errors.ARC3ValidationError: credential-bearing field 'CREDENTIALS' is forbidden in receipts
failure.cause: The property generator described all generated mappings as valid while allowing key names that the receipt schema intentionally rejects. Platform/example variation exposed the invalid generator domain.

correction.measurement_note: The local strategy correction was measured uncommitted, then committed and verified by both push and pull-request CI matrices.
correction.change: Prefix recursively generated mapping keys with field_ so the arbitrary round-trip domain excludes schema-reserved credential and reasoning field names; explicit rejection tests remain unchanged.
